lesson_title, grade, entry_year, semester, lesson_num, shuffle_mode, random_choice_count, random_judgment_count, lesson_mode, teacher_note, auto_advance_enabled, auto_advance_threshold_pct, auto_advance_delay_hours, auto_advance_ready_time, creator_id, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time,
#{lessonTitle}, #{grade}, #{entryYear}, #{semester}, #{lessonNum}, #{shuffleMode}, #{randomChoiceCount}, #{randomJudgmentCount}, #{lessonMode}, #{teacherNote}, #{autoAdvanceEnabled}, #{autoAdvanceThresholdPct}, #{autoAdvanceDelayHours}, #{autoAdvanceReadyTime}, #{creatorId}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime},
mapper.update: update biz_lesson set auto_advance_ready_time = null where lesson_id = #{lessonId}
mapper.select: select lesson_id, lesson_title, grade, entry_year, semester, lesson_num, shuffle_mode, random_choice_count, random_judgment_count, lesson_mode, teacher_note, auto_advance_enabled, auto_advance_threshold_pct, auto_advance_delay_hours, auto_advance_ready_time, creator_id, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from biz_lesson where create_by = #{creatorName} and dept_id = #{deptId} and IFNULL(lesson_mode, 'assessment') <> 'attendance' order by update_time desc, lesson_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lesson_advance_policy (teacher_id, dept_id, auto_advance_enabled, auto_advance_threshold_pct, auto_advance_delay_hours, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{teacherId}, #{deptId}, #{autoAdvanceEnabled}, #{autoAdvanceThresholdPct}, #{autoAdvanceDelayHours}, #{updateBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now()) on duplicate key update auto_advance_enabled = values(auto_advance_enabled), auto_advance_threshold_pct = values(auto_advance_threshold_pct), auto_advance_delay_hours = values(auto_advance_delay_hours), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = values(update_time)
mapper.update: update biz_lesson set auto_advance_enabled = #{autoAdvanceEnabled}, auto_advance_threshold_pct = #{autoAdvanceThresholdPct}, auto_advance_delay_hours = #{autoAdvanceDelayHours}, auto_advance_ready_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where (creator_id = #{teacherId} or (creator_id is null and create_by = #{creatorName})) and dept_id = #{deptId} and IFNULL(lesson_mode, 'assessment') <> 'attendance'
mapper.select: select distinct l.lesson_id, l.lesson_title, l.grade, l.entry_year, l.semester, l.lesson_num, l.shuffle_mode, l.random_choice_count, l.random_judgment_count, l.lesson_mode, l.teacher_note, l.auto_advance_enabled, l.auto_advance_threshold_pct, l.auto_advance_delay_hours, l.auto_advance_ready_time, l.creator_id, l.dept_id, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time from biz_lesson l inner join biz_lesson_assignment a on a.lesson_id = l.lesson_id where IFNULL(l.auto_advance_enabled, 0) = 1 and IFNULL(l.lesson_mode, 'assessment') <> 'attendance'

mapper.select: SELECT lesson_id, lesson_title, lesson_num, entry_year, create_time, 'self' as course_type, (SELECT count(1) FROM biz_lesson_question lq LEFT JOIN biz_question q ON lq.question_id = q.question_id WHERE lq.lesson_id = biz_lesson.lesson_id AND q.question_type = 'practical') > 0 as has_practical, IFNULL(lesson_mode, 'assessment') as lesson_mode, IFNULL(auto_advance_enabled, 0) as auto_advance_enabled, IFNULL(auto_advance_threshold_pct, 50) as auto_advance_threshold_pct, IFNULL(auto_advance_delay_hours, 2.0) as auto_advance_delay_hours FROM biz_lesson WHERE entry_year = #{entryYear} AND create_by = #{creatorName} AND dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, lesson_id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT l.lesson_id, l.lesson_title, l.lesson_num, l.entry_year, l.create_time, 'shared' as course_type, (SELECT count(1) FROM biz_lesson_question lq LEFT JOIN biz_question q ON lq.question_id = q.question_id WHERE lq.lesson_id = l.lesson_id AND q.question_type = 'practical') > 0 as has_practical, IFNULL(l.lesson_mode, 'assessment') as lesson_mode, IFNULL(l.auto_advance_enabled, 0) as auto_advance_enabled, IFNULL(l.auto_advance_threshold_pct, 50) as auto_advance_threshold_pct, IFNULL(l.auto_advance_delay_hours, 2.0) as auto_advance_delay_hours FROM biz_lesson l INNER JOIN biz_lesson_assignment la ON l.lesson_id = la.lesson_id INNER JOIN biz_teacher_class tc ON la.entry_year = tc.entry_year AND la.class_code = tc.class_code AND la.dept_id = tc.dept_id WHERE tc.user_id = #{userId} AND tc.dept_id = #{deptId} AND l.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND la.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND l.create_by != #{creatorName} ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.lesson_id DESC
